target.title: fix: guard generated video downloads [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users generating videos from providers that return URL-only assets could have the CLI download provider-supplied URLs without applying the configured provider request network policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The CLI now resolves the selected provider's request policy for URL-only generated video assets and downloads them through the guarded provider HTTP path. This preserves streaming output and in-memory size caps while keeping provider request config as the opt-in path for private-network downloads.

## User Impact

CLI video generation keeps working for normal provider-hosted media, blocks private/internal download targets by default, and still permits configured private-network providers when operators opt into that request policy.

Release-note-style behavior note: URL-only generated video downloads that resolve to private/internal networks now fail closed unless the selected provider already has `models.providers.<provider>.request.allowPrivateNetwork` enabled.
